properties.name: In the Western Atlantic
properties.said:
USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN 69) Nimitz-class aircraft carrier coming into Norfolk, Virginia after the September 28 incident that injured four sailors and resulted in the loss of a EA-18G Growler. According to Naval Air Force Atlantic, the return to port will “allow for a… pic.twitter.com/ELk3hDmGSQ

— WarshipCam (@WarshipCam) October 5, 2026

Aircraft carrier USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN-69) arrived Monday in Norfolk, Va., following the loss of an EA-18G Growler due to a carrier launch and recovery system mishap on Sept. 28. The mishap occurred during an underway in the Western Atlantic.

USS San Antonio (LPD-17) is operating off the coast of Virginia. The amphibious ship previously operated in the Caribbean with elements of the 24th Marine Expeditionary Unit as Littoral Combat Force 24.

In addition to these major formations, not shown are others serving in submarines, individual surface ships, aircraft squadrons, SEALs, Special Purpose Marine Air-Ground Task Forces, Seabees, EOD Mobile Units and more throughout the globe.
